messages:
jordan-cust: Hey @support, we started seeing spikes in latency and a bunch of 403s today. App is pinned to us-east-1 but our logs show requests routed to eu-west-1 and failing with auth_mismatch. Any ideas?

maria: Sorry about that — can you paste a scrubbed request_id and a snippet of the client config?

jordan-cust: request_id=req_20260317_01
client config: `region: 'us-east-1', retryMode: 'adaptive', timeoutMs: 1200, hedgedRequests: true`
logs: ```
[req_20260317_01] attempt=1 region=us-east-1 latency=1205ms status=timeout
[req_20260317_01] attempt=2 region=eu-west-1 latency=85ms status=403 error=auth_token_region_mismatch
[req_20260317_01] routed_to=eu-west-1 via=client-retry
```

sam: that pattern screams hedged/parallel retries causing region-hopping when primary times out. SDK will try another region variant, but token/account bindings are region-scoped -> 403.

alex: Confirming — we shipped a hedged-request optimization in the client SDK last quarter that triggers a second attempt to a different endpoint if the first exceeds 1s. It was intended for latency SLOs but we didn't gate it by account-region affinity.

maria: Oof. That explains the auth_mismatch. Also could explain billing noise since cross-region calls may be charged differently.

jordan-cust: Is there a quick mitigation? We need to stop cross-region calls immediately.

ops-oncall: We can push a server-side short-term guard: respect X-Account-Region header and reject cross-region requests (503 -> do not fallback). Deploying rule now to drop any routed request where header != endpoint region unless allowed by ops.

sam: Client-side quick fixes you can do immediately: disable hedgedRequests, set timeoutMs to 5000 (or higher), and set regionAffinity: true. Example:```js
const client = new RedwoodClient({
  region: 'us-east-1',
  retryMode: 'standard',
  hedgedRequests: false,
  regionAffinity: true,
  timeoutMs: 5000
});
```

jordan-cust: Good, we'll patch that. How should we repro so we can write a test?

alex: Repro steps we've used in staging: 1) configure client with hedgedRequests:true and timeoutMs low (<=1200). 2) Simulate network slowness to primary region (delay first attempt > timeout). 3) Observe second attempt routed to alternate region and failing with 403 due to token-region claim. Capture traces with `x-rw-trace` header.

sam: Helpful curl example to reproduce locally (scrub keys):```bash
curl -v -H "Authorization: Bearer <token>" -H "X-Account-Region: us-east-1" -H "X-RW-Trace: dbg-1" \
  https://api.redwood-inference.com/v1/generate --data '{"prompt":"hi"}'
```
Then add artificial delay_rule for us-east-1 in our test router to cause timeout.

maria: For the long-term fix: we should make hedged retries region-aware — only hedge within the same region (different AZ/endpoint) or probe token region claim before attempting cross-region fallback. Also add a server-side opt-in that allows specific accounts to fallback cross-region if they've opted in and tokens support it.

alex: Agreed. Plan: (1) patch SDK default to hedgedRequests=false across GA release, (2) add regionAffinity flag default true, (3) implement token-region preflight check in the runtime so fallback won't attempt if mismatch. I'll open an RFC and ship a patch. Ticket: ENG-RT-2345.

ops-oncall: Mitigation deployed: server rule rejecting cross-region requests for accounts without cross-region flag. Rolling back if it causes issues.

jordan-cust: Thanks — disabling hedgedRequests and bumping timeouts fixed the immediate 403s in our QA. Will keep you posted after prod rollout. :thumbsup:

maria: Please file a support ticket with postmortem notes (include request_id samples). We'll follow up on billing adjustments if cross-region charges appeared.

jordan-cust: Filed ticket SUP-6421 with logs and billing question.

support-bot: Automated note: escalation created ENG-RT-2345 for runtime/SDK hedged retry behavior.

alex: I'll prioritize the SDK default change and add unit/regression tests to cover token-region case.

jordan-cust: Appreciate the fast response. Will validate in 30m and update.

maria: Thanks everyone, tracking in SUP-6421 & ENG-RT-2345. :white_check_mark:
